$comment: Truthful service descriptor for the Citrus Coast AI teardown API. This service is a REST + x402 endpoint, NOT an MCP server — it must NOT be submitted to MCP Registry as an MCP server. MCP Registry is inapplicable (no MCP interface). Correct indexes: CDP Bazaar / PayAI Bazaar (settlement-triggered discovery), x402scan, 402index.io.
description: Deterministic AI-visibility teardown for local service businesses: 11 live checks, 0-100 score, findings, 30-day fixes. $0.50 USDC on Base per API call via x402 (verify then settle). Pre-pay check: $0.001 USDC per call, verdict on an x402 endpoint before paying it (live 402 vs public listing). Citrus Coast Evidence Audit: $0.50 USDC per call, deterministic analysis of caller-supplied URLs/source briefs; unsupported requests return insufficient-evidence, sources never fabricated.

endpoints.note: x402 pre-pay check: verdict on an x402 endpoint before paying it
x402 paid Citrus Coast Evidence Audit: analysis of caller-supplied URLs/source briefs, $0.50 USDC on Base
free human tier, 3/day per IP, HTML report

name: citrus-coast-ai-teardown

prepay_check.settle: POST /settle after /verify; verdict delivered only after successful settle; settlement tx hash returned in X-PAYMENT-RESPONSE header and body.settlement

evidence_check.settle: POST /settle after /verify; analysis delivered only after successful settle; settlement tx hash returned in X-PAYMENT-RESPONSE header and body.settlement.tx_hash
evidence_check.note: Caller-supplied sources only; naked claim/question with no retrievable supplied sources returns insufficient_sources; sources are never fabricated

x402.settle: POST /settle after /verify; report delivered only after successful settle; settlement tx hash returned in X-PAYMENT-RESPONSE header and body.settlement
